new_destinations.name: Taveuni
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Taveuni" (garden island, 180th meridian); Rainbow Reef lies off its coast.

new_destinations.name: Vanua Levu
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Vanua Levu" (Savusavu redirects to it; covers Savusavu and Labasa). Region used because Savusavu has only three own kept spots.

spots.name: Tavoro Waterfalls
spots.bio_draft: Waterfalls (nature): three falls in Bouma park, the most accessible on Taveuni, 15 minutes to an hour's walk.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Lavena Coastal Walk
spots.bio_draft: Walk (coastal track): about four hours return from Lavena village to a swimming hole and waterfalls, with a small fee.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Des Voeux Peak
spots.bio_draft: Peak (mountain): Fiji's second-highest peak at 1,196 m, reached by hike or 4WD, with birdlife.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Rainbow Reef
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: Reef (dive area): patch reef in the Somosomo Strait between Taveuni and Vanua Levu, one of the South Pacific's best-known dive sites.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Waitabu Marine Park
spots.bio_draft: Marine park (community reef): 1 km of fringing reef protected by seven communities, with snorkelling.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Lake Tagimaucia
spots.bio_draft: Lake (crater lake): volcanic crater lake at about 800 m, habitat of the tagimaucia flower, reached by guided hike.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Beverley Beach
spots.source_region: added by caller (Rough Guides names Beverley Beach, Matei, for snorkelling)
spots.bio_draft: White-sand beach at Matei on Taveuni, named by Rough Guides for snorkelling.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Vidawa Rainforest Hike
spots.bio_draft: Walk (guided rainforest hike): full-day guided hike to archaeological sites and viewpoints, ending at the lower Tavoro falls.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Waitavala Waterslide
spots.bio_draft: Waterslide (natural rock slide): cool natural rock slide and swimming hole on a stream.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Wairiki Mission Church
spots.bio_draft: Religious building (mission church): Taveuni Catholic church on a hill above a coconut plantation, with views of the historic battle beach.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Taveuni and reached from that base.

spots.name: Savusavu
spots.bio_draft: Town on Vanua Levu's south coast: yachting anchorage, diving base and hot springs, the island's main tourist centre.
spots.reason: Town with hot springs, anchorage and diving base; has draws no other spot covers.

spots.name: Waisali Rainforest Reserve
spots.bio_draft: Protected rainforest reserve (nature park) just outside Savusavu, about 130 ha, with birds, frogs and a waterfall walk; run with the National Trust of Fiji.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Vanua Levu and reached from that base.

spots.name: Labasa
spots.bio_draft: Town: largest town on Vanua Levu and its administrative and sugar centre, with a bus hub and Indo-Fijian market life.
spots.reason: Largest Vanua Levu town and bus hub; its market and temple are only review candidates, so the town itself is the spot.

spots.name: Savusavu Hills
spots.bio_draft: Walk (hike): hill ridge above Savusavu with bay views, 30 minutes to a few hours by route.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Vanua Levu and reached from that base.

spots.name: Lesiaceva Point
spots.bio_draft: Headland (viewpoint and beach): south coast point near Savusavu, with a public snorkelling beach at Split Rock.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Vanua Levu and reached from that base.

review_list_not_placed.name: Great Sea Reef
review_list_not_placed.objection: Remote area rather than a place; for: third-longest barrier reef

review_list_not_placed.objection: Part of the larger Rainbow Reef spot (rule 3); for: it is the name divers search for
